# Install `mdx-blog` — MDX Blog

> Markdown-with-JSX untuk blog post.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/mdx-blog
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=mdx-blog
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/mdx-blog

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add mdx-blog
# alias: npx rr add mdx-blog
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `content`, `blog`, `mdx`, `static`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add mdx-blog`. Store post body sebagai markdown di content/blog/*.mdx. Render dengan MDXRemote di [slug]/page.tsx. Auto-extract headings ke ToC via remark plugin custom.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
- Full ruleset: https://resource.rahmanef.com/best-practice
